text: April 9, 2026 - Ludic, Ludian, or Ludic Karelian (Luudi, Lyydi or lüüdi), is a Finnic language in the Uralic language family or a third supradialect of Karelian. It is transitional between the Olonets Karelian language and the Veps language.

title: Harmony by the Mountains - The hidden world of Uralic languages
text: January 29, 2025 - One of the most remarkable things about Uralic languages is how they sound. Vowel harmony, a feature where vowels within a word harmonize to sound more fluid, is a key trait of many Uralic languages. This gives them a certain musicality and softness that can be quite appealing to the ear.
